description: Building AstroNav, an interactive lunar landing site navigation and risk evaluation tool for Artemis missions using NASA LROC & LOLA data.
summary: AstroNav is an interactive lunar landing site navigation and risk evaluation prototype designed for Artemis missions. It utilizes a custom exploratory scoring formula based on parameters like illumination, Earth visibility, absolute latitude, and slope to screen and rank candidate landing sites efficiently.
details: AstroNav is an interactive lunar landing site navigation and risk evaluation tool designed for Artemis missions. It utilizes HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to analyze key parameters like illumination, Earth visibility, absolute latitude, and slope to assess landing site safety and direct-to-Earth communication windows efficiently
